ideas.pitch: An interactive step-through debugger specifically designed for IOI-style competitive programming problems, letting students visualize graph traversals, DP tables, and segment trees in real time.
ideas.title: IOI Visualizer & Algorithmic Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting an IOI-inspired contest like Procon Jr., judges and participants heavily value deep algorithmic clarity and debugging tools that make complex logic understandable.

ideas.pitch: A personalized skill gap analyzer that ingests past contest submissions, identifies weak algorithmic paradigms (e.g., dynamic programming vs. greedy), and generates targeted practice sets.
ideas.title: CodeClimb: Competitive Programming Progress Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the competitive programming focus of Procon Jr. by addressing the exact preparation needs of school students aiming for IIIT-Delhi admissions.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, low-latency live coding duel platform featuring automated test case generation and real-time execution comparisons for school-level coders.
ideas.title: AlgoDuel: P2P Synchronous Code Battle Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering in handling real-time WebSocket communication and secure code sandboxing within a tight timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A static analysis tool that parses competitive programming submissions to estimate time and space complexities (Big-O notation) and warn students of potential TLE (Time Limit Exceeded) errors before submission.
ideas.title: ComplexityCrunch: Static Code Complexity Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable pain point for every competitive programmer participating in contests like Procon Jr.

ideas.pitch: A predictive modeling tool that maps JEE Main percentiles and Procon Jr. bonus points to historical JAC counselling cutoff trends to help students optimize their college preferences.
ideas.title: JAC-RankPredictor: IIIT-Delhi Admission Calculator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly ties into the unique academic benefit of Procon Jr. (bonus points for IIIT-Delhi admissions), making it immediately useful and engaging for every participant and organizer.
